name: Gedor
overview: Gedor is a male figure from the tribe of Benjamin, known primarily as the son of Jeiel and Maacah. His mention in Scripture is brief, with no additional notes or attributes recorded beyond his lineage. He appears in the genealogical records of 1 Chronicles 8:31.
namesAndTitles: The name Gedor is a proper name meaning 'wall' or 'pock-marked,' reflecting a Hebrew origin. This name is not indicated to have been given directly by God but carries a meaning that may imply strength or a distinctive characteristic.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Gedor as the son of Jeiel and Maacah, placing him within the family line of the tribe of Benjamin. No other family relationships are documented beyond this parentage.
scriptureSignificance: Gedor's significance lies in his inclusion in the genealogical records of the tribe of Benjamin, which underscores the importance of preserving the lineage and heritage of God's people. Although not highlighted for specific deeds or roles, his mention contributes to the biblical emphasis on family lines and tribal identity within the nation of Israel.
